gates.claim: THE CORRECTION. SnapPy's three 5_2 shapes are (y_1, 1/(1-y_1), y_1) -- they are NOT all equal. An earlier version of FiveTwoVolumeConstant.lean modelled the triangulation as `const 3 fiveTwoTet` (all shape y_1); that was wrong, and this gate exists so the error cannot recur silently

THE MAIN RESULT, AND IT IS SYMBOLIC. All 5 gluing equations -- 3 edge, 2 cusp -- hold EXACTLY over the shape field Q[y]/(y^3-2y^2+3y-1). Each product minus 1, with denominators cleared, reduces to 0 modulo the minimal polynomial. No floating point is involved anywhere in this gate

why Vol = 3 D(y_1) SURVIVES the correction, as a reason rather than a coincidence: z -> 1/(1-z) cyclically permutes the three dihedral angles, since 1/(1 - 1/(1-z)) = 1 - 1/z and 1 - 1/(1/(1-z)) = z. So Lam(th1)+Lam(th2)+Lam(th3) is unchanged -- proved in Lean as IdealTetrahedron.rotate_angles / volume_rotate

SCOPE. Verified here: that the ALGEBRAIC shapes satisfy SnapPy's gluing equations exactly. NOT verified, and not statable in Lean today: that this triangulation is a triangulation OF the topological manifold S^3 \ 5_2. That is Thurston hyperbolisation plus Mostow rigidity and needs hyperbolic 3-manifolds, which neither Mathlib nor QOU has. Nor is the 5_2 volume conjecture (Ohtsuki 2016) touched

verdict.proved_symbolically: the exact algebraic shapes (y_1, 1/(1-y_1), y_1) satisfy all 5 of SnapPy's 5_2 gluing equations over Q[y]/(y^3-2y^2+3y-1), residual 0.
verdict.corrected: the triangulation is NOT three copies of y_1; the middle tetrahedron is 1/(1-y_1). Vol = 3 D(y_1) survives because the relabelling cycles the angles -- now a theorem, not an assumption.
verdict.not_established: that this is a triangulation of S^3 \ 5_2 (not statable in Lean).
